annotations.title: A vault’s holder book against its supply

description: One vault’s holder book against its supply: where the book comes from (share transfers folded to a block, or the venue’s position list), the block and its hash, when it was observed, indexed, read and priced, the holders’ raw share sum against totalSupply() with zero address and unassigned fee shares handled, and the state: complete (same block, they agree), partial, stale (different blocks or older than 36 hours) or unavailable, with the reason. Say “100%” only when complete; otherwise approximate / not reconciled. Also the largest holder and five largest with lower and upper bounds, the price state (ok, stale, zero, missing: never a silent zero) and the vaults that hold this one or that it holds, each edge with its proof (an adapter that names the child on chain, or the parent’s own contract) and whether it was deduplicated in the look-through total. Addresses, not owners. FREE.
